tasks.description: Create modern pyproject.toml with Python 3.10, JAX CUDA 12 dependencies, and uv-compatible configuration.

steps.description: Define project metadata with name, version, and description
Set Python version constraint to >=3.10,<3.11 for ROS2 Humble compatibility
Extract pure Python dependencies from environment.yml pip section
Create [project.optional-dependencies] with cuda12 extra for GPU support
Configure uv tool settings and setuptools backend

tasks.acceptance-criteria: pyproject.toml exists in project root with valid TOML syntax. Core dependencies include jax, flax, optax, orbax-checkpoint, numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, pyyaml. Python version constraint is >=3.10,<3.11. Optional cuda12 extra includes jax[cuda12] for GPU acceleration. Running uv sync successfully creates .venv and installs all packages.

unit: pyproject.toml parses as valid TOML without syntax errors
Project metadata contains name='lotf' and version='0.1.0'
Python requires field equals '>=3.10,<3.11'
Core dependencies list includes jax, flax, optax, numpy, scipy
Optional dependencies contain cuda12 extra with jax[cuda12]
integration: uv sync command completes without errors
uv run python -c 'import jax; import flax; import optax' succeeds
uv run python -c 'import lotf' succeeds after package installation
e2e-manual: Verify CUDA is available: uv run python -c 'import jax; print(jax.devices())' shows GPU device

tasks.description: Implement a clean configuration loader that parses YAML files and returns typed dataclass configs.

steps.description: Create lotf/configs/__init__.py with config module exports
Define dataclass configs for training, environment, and simulation parameters
Implement load_config function using pyyaml with file path and optional overrides
Add config validation with clear error messages for missing or invalid fields
Create merge_config utility for combining base configs with experiment overrides

tasks.acceptance-criteria: lotf/configs/__init__.py exists and exports load_config function. Config dataclasses define TrainingConfig, EnvConfig, SimConfig with type hints. load_config accepts YAML file path and returns frozen dataclass instance. Invalid YAML paths raise FileNotFoundError with helpful message. Missing required fields raise ValidationError with field name. merge_config correctly overrides nested values from dict to dataclass.

merge_config overrides scalar values correctly
merge_config preserves unspecified nested values

tasks.task: Create modular training script for state hovering
tasks.description: Extract and modularize the state hovering training logic from notebook into executable Python script.

steps.description: Create lotf/scripts/__init__.py with script module exports
Create train_state_hovering.py with argparse CLI for config path and checkpoint output
Implement create_env function that builds HoveringStateEnv from config
Implement create_policy function that builds MLP and TrainState from config
Implement main training loop using bptt.train with progress callbacks
Add checkpoint save functionality using orbax PyTreeCheckpointer

tasks.acceptance-criteria: lotf/scripts/train_state_hovering.py exists and is executable via uv run python -m lotf scripts.train_state_hovering. CLI accepts --config path argument with default configs/state_hovering.yaml. CLI accepts --output path argument for checkpoint save location. Script loads config, creates environment, initializes policy, runs training loop, and saves final checkpoint. Training produces identical results to notebook when using same config parameters.

unit: create_env returns HoveringStateEnv with correct observation and action spaces
create_policy returns TrainState with correct parameter shapes
argparse CLI parses --config and --output flags correctly
checkpoint save creates file at specified output path
integration: uv run python -m lotf.scripts.train_state_hovering --config configs/state_hovering.yaml runs without errors
Training with default config completes max_epochs iterations
Output checkpoint file loads successfully with PyTreeCheckpointer
e2e-manual: Training reward curve visually matches notebook output for same hyperparameters

tasks.description: Extract and modularize the residual dynamics ensemble training logic from notebook into executable Python script.

steps.description: Create train_residual.py with argparse CLI for config, dataset, and output paths

Implement create_ensemble function that initializes multiple models from config

Script loads CSV dataset, initializes ensemble models, runs vectorized training, and saves final parameters. Training output includes per-epoch MSE loss logging for each ensemble member.
